# Podcasts for Example Founder to go on

Seven shows are worth pitching now, one of them a long shot. Start with Bootstrapped Builders: its listeners are the product's buyers and it booked a founder running a company with agents in August. Four emails, one form, one message and one intro are drafted below, and one bigger show needs a conference talk first.

## Next steps

1. Email guests@bootstrappedbuilders.example.com with the Bootstrapped Builders draft.
2. Email guests@agentopsweekly.example.com with the Agent Ops Weekly draft.
3. Email guests@giriimsohbetleri.example.com with the Turkish draft for Girişim Sohbetleri.
4. Email guests@citedweekly.example.com with the Cited Weekly draft.
5. Fill in the Solo SaaS Hour guest form with the answers below.
6. Message The Inference Hour's host with the draft below.
7. Ask a contact to forward the Teknoloji Notları intro.
8. Submit the Frontier Engineers conference talk by 2026-10-11.

## Picks

### 1. Bootstrapped Builders

**Why this show:** Its listeners run small SaaS companies, the people who buy the product. In August it booked Riley Example to talk about running a company with agents, which is the room this founder speaks to.

- **Odds:** likely: it booked a founder running a company with agents in August
- **Show:** https://bootstrappedbuilders.example.com
- **Listeners:** about 6,000 per episode, reach score 61, 140 Apple ratings (Podscan estimates)
- **Guest like you:** Riley Example, ["Running a company with agents"](https://example.com/ep/42), 2026-08-14
- **How to reach them:** email guests@bootstrappedbuilders.example.com, published on [the guests page](https://bootstrappedbuilders.example.com/guests)
- **Worth knowing:** nothing

**Subject:** What breaks when agents run growth for 100 SaaS products

**Email:**

> Hi Sam,
>
> In the Riley Example episode you asked whether anyone trusts an agent with a customer's ad budget. We do, for about 100 small SaaS products, and the answer was no for the first two months.
>
> I'm the founding engineer at a seed-stage startup that runs SEO, content and ads for those products. I'd tell the story of the week our agents rewrote 40 landing pages and what we changed after.
>
> Would that work for an episode?
>
> Ahmet

**Follow-up a week later:**

> Hi Sam, one more detail: we now keep every agent change behind a human review, and the numbers changed a lot. Happy to bring them.

### 6. The Inference Hour

**Why this show:** Its listeners build with models, and its recent guests are engineers with production data.

- **Show:** https://theinferencehour.example.com
- **Listeners:** about 6,000 per episode (Podscan estimate)
- **Guest like you:** Riley Example, ["Running a company with agents"](https://example.com/ep/42), 2026-08-14
- **How to reach them:** a message to the host on the channel linked from [its site](https://theinferencehour.example.com)
- **Worth knowing:** lists a $300 "featured guest" package on its sponsor page; free interviews also run.

**Message:**

> Your eval harness episode stuck with me. I run a fleet of coding agents on 100 real businesses and have a year of failure data. Want it for a show?

## Ladder

### Frontier Engineers

**Why this show:** The biggest show for engineers building agents, but every recent guest arrived through the hosts' conference.

- **Show:** https://frontierengineers.example.com
- **Why not now:** every recent guest had first spoken at the hosts' conference.
- **First step:** give a talk at the hosts' conference on agent infrastructure.
- **Deadline:** 2026-10-11

**Talk title:** What 100 businesses taught us about running coding agents in production.

## Who these shows reach

- **Small SaaS founders** (buyers, English): they buy the product, and the founder runs growth for about 100 of their peers' products. Picked: Bootstrapped Builders, Solo SaaS Hour.
- **Engineers building agents** (craft, English): few engineers run a fleet of coding agents on real businesses every day. Picked: Agent Ops Weekly, The Inference Hour.
- **Turkish tech and startups** (home, Turkish): a Turkish engineer at a US venture-backed AI startup is rare there. Picked: Girişim Sohbetleri, Teknoloji Notları.
- **AI search and content marketing** (topic, English): the founder has data across 100 sites. Picked: Cited Weekly.
